_comment: High/critical advisories in backend production dependencies accepted for now. Each entry needs a reason and a review-by date; the CI audit step fails once the date passes or when the advisory is no longer reported (so the entry is removed). See docs/security.md.

GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m.reason: DoS via a pending async fileFilter. Not reachable: no route uses file uploads (no FileInterceptor/multer usage in backend/src). Pulled in by @nestjs/platform-express 11.2.7, which pins multer to exactly 2.4.0, so a lockfile-only bump can't reach the fixed 2.5.0. Clear it with a Nest release that bumps multer, or an npm override.
